Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Suresh - 38 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Rohan stands by the road. Pallavi and Suresh stand near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rohan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Suresh: "Yes, all right."

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Pallavi (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Rohan gets off the school bus.]

Rohan: "One more time!"

[Rohan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Suresh: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Rohan: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Rohan helps Mother get up.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Rohan: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Pallavi and Suresh stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Rohan reads a storybook.]

Pallavi: "Yes, all right."

[Rohan studies for his exam.]

Rohan: "Hmm, I see."

[Rohan types on his laptop.]

Suresh (laughing): "What happened?"

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Rohan stands in the bedroom. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan yawns loudly.]

Pallavi: "Show me too!"

[Rohan stretches his arms above his head.]

Rohan (surprised): "That's easy."

[Rohan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Pallavi: "Really?"

[Rohan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
